name: Sichuan Em Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Em Technology Co., Ltd., based in Mianyang, China, is a company primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of advanced materials across China. The firm offers a wide array of specialized products, including various types of films such as electrical and electronic insulation films, optical PET films, polyester films, capacitor PP films, PVB resins and films, as well as polycarbonate and polypropylene films and sheets. Additionally, its extensive portfolio features electrical insulation materials, composite materials, thermosetting composites, flame retardant substances, and unique resins. The company also supplies PET chips, adhesive tapes, protection films, fabricated products, resin specifically for CCL (Copper Clad Laminates), and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) along with their intermediates.
